newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein stable, CPO tender done.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein stable, CPO tender done.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were mostly stable in late trading on Friday as buyers remained sidelined due to the holiday season, traders said.
They said olein was quoted at 1,435-40 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from the opening, but offers were also heard at 1,430 rupiah for purchases exceeding 100 tonnes.
A 500-tonne crude palm oil tender was done at an equivalent of 1,075.11 rupiah/kg, excluding tax and transportation costs, in the North Sumatran city of Medan on Friday.
"There was not much activity today because most players are already on holiday," one trader said.
